'''Red''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[orlax]] developed in [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation's]] [[CI-004 Research Facility]] on [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]]. Around [[3627 BBY]], an outbreak on the facility led to Red escaping and [[Death/Legends|killing]] [[Wen Radler]]. Soon after, she was killed by a strike team [[CI-004 Incident|sent]] to handle the situation.<ref name="OP" />

Red was able to expel [[hydrochloric acid]] from her body.<ref name="OP" />
